title: Hangikjöt
description: A traditional dish from Iceland, centered on lamb, smoked salt, potato, frozen green peas. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Fresh lamb seasoned with smoked salt replaces traditional Icelandic cold-smoked hangikjöt, which is unavailable in the catalog.

steps.instruction: Poach the listed ingredients in barely simmering liquid for about 55 minutes until tender and cooked through.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 24 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 30 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
